details.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
details.sql:
WITH min_consumption_per_customer AS (
  SELECT c.customerid, c.segment, c.currency,
         MIN(y.consumption) as min_consumption
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.date::date) = 2013
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment, c.currency
),
min_consumption_values AS (
  SELECT customerid, segment, min_consumption
  FROM min_consumption_per_customer
  ORDER BY min_consumption ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
relevant_customers AS (
  SELECT c.segment
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.date::date) = 2013
  AND c.customerid IN (SELECT customerid FROM min_consumption_values)
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
avg_consumption AS (
  SELECT c.segment, AVG(y.consumption) as annual_avg
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.date::date) = 2013
  AND c.customerid IN (SELECT customerid FROM min_consumption_values)
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN a.segment = 'SME' THEN a.annual_avg - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE segment = 'LAM')
    WHEN a.segment = 'LAM' THEN (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE segment = 'SME') - a.annual_avg
    WHEN a.segment = 'KAM' THEN (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE segment = 'LAM')
    ELSE NULL
  END as segment_difference
FROM avg_consumption a
WHERE a.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
ORDER BY segment_difference DESC

details.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
details.sql:
WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(y.date, 'YYYYMMDD')) = 2012 THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(y.date, 'YYYYMMDD')) = 2013 THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    CASE
        WHEN consumption_2012 > 0 THEN ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012)
        ELSE 0
    END AS percentage_increase
FROM segment_consumption
WHERE segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC

details.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT customerid
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE date = '2012-08-25'
    AND amount = 634.8
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) as total_consumption_2012
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid FROM target_customer)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date::date) = 2012
    GROUP BY customerid
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) as total_consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid FROM target_customer)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date::date) = 2013
    GROUP BY customerid
)
SELECT
    t.customerid,
    c2.total_consumption_2012,
    c3.total_consumption_2013,
    ROUND(((c2.total_consumption_2012 - c3.total_consumption_2013) / c2.total_consumption_2012 * 100)::numeric, 2) as decrease_rate
FROM target_customer t
JOIN consumption_2012 c2 ON t.customerid = c2.customerid
JOIN consumption_2013 c3 ON t.customerid = c3.customerid

         MIN(y.consumption) as min_consumption
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.date) = 2013
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
least_consumers AS (
  SELECT lc.customerid, lc.segment
  FROM least_consumption lc
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT segment, MIN(min_consumption) as min_cons
    FROM least_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
  ) mc ON lc.segment = mc.segment AND lc.min_consumption = mc.min_cons
),
avg_consumption AS (

  INNER JOIN least_consumers lc ON c.customerid = lc.customerid
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
differences AS (

    CASE
      WHEN avg_consumption.segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption.annual_avg -
           (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE segment = 'LAM')
      WHEN avg_consumption.segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption.annual_avg -

details.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
details.sql:
WITH min_consumption AS (
  SELECT c.customerid, MIN(y.consumption) as min_val
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(y.date, 'YYYYMM')) = 2013
  AND c.currency = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY c.customerid
),
qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT c.customerid, c.segment, c.currency,
         y.consumption
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  INNER JOIN min_consumption mc ON c.customerid = mc.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(y.date, 'YYYYMM')) = 2013
  AND y.consumption = mc.min_val
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT segment, AVG(consumption) as annual_avg
  FROM qualified_customers
  WHERE segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY segment
),
comparison_results AS (
  SELECT
    'SME vs LAM' as comparison,
    sa1.annual_avg - sa2.annual_avg as diff
  FROM segment_avg sa1
  CROSS JOIN segment_avg sa2
  WHERE sa1.segment = 'SME' AND sa2.segment = 'LAM'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'LAM vs KAM' as comparison,
    sa1.annual_avg - sa2.annual_avg as diff
  FROM segment_avg sa1
  CROSS JOIN segment_avg sa2
  WHERE sa1.segment = 'LAM' AND sa2.segment = 'KAM'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'KAM vs SME' as comparison,
    sa1.annual_avg - sa2.annual_avg as diff
  FROM segment_avg sa1
  CROSS JOIN segment_avg sa2
  WHERE sa1.segment = 'KAM' AND sa2.segment = 'SME'
)
SELECT comparison, diff
FROM comparison_results
ORDER BY comparison

details.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
details.sql:
WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        c.currency,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(ym.date, 'YYYYMM')) as year,
        SUM(ym.consumption) as consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(ym.date, 'YYYYMM')) IN (2012, 2013)
    GROUP BY c.segment, c.currency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(ym.date, 'YYYYMM'))
),
percentage_increase AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) as consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) as consumption_2013,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)::float - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)::float) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)::float, 0) * 100 as percentage_increase
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
),
biggest_increase AS (
    SELECT * FROM percentage_increase
    ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_increase AS (
    SELECT * FROM percentage_increase
    ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    'biggest_increase' as category,
    segment,
    percentage_increase
FROM biggest_increase
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'lowest_increase' as category,
    segment,
    percentage_increase
FROM lowest_increase

consumption_2012 AS (

consumption_2013 AS (

WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.customerid AS cid, c.currency AS currency

    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid
    GROUP BY c.customerid, c.currency
    ORDER BY SUM(t.price) DESC
    LIMIT 1

    tc.currency,
    AVG(t.price) as avg_price_per_item
